summary: Restyle the app from warm paper / serif / bookmark red to a cool grey page with white large-radius cards, pill controls, heavy sans headings and one blue accent, in light and dark mode. Tokens in theme.css drive every page; the main page's visual layer was restyled by hand.
scope_note: Worktree ui-elavatine, branched from main 0c288b3. No .app build by design.

budget_impact.rationale: Presentation only: CSS tokens and rules. No model call, no network, no stored data or prompt change.
budget_impact.before: warm paper, serif headings, red accent
budget_impact.after: cool grey, sans headings, blue accent; same model-token use (zero)
budget_impact.developer_usage: none: no model call was made for this unit

open_risks: Learning-map graph, import batches, weekly report and project switcher were not seen with real content.
Logo and favicon keep the old cream and red colours.
No native window check and no release build.
